title.narrative: Lifesaving severe acute malnutrition treatment services for children under five and pregnant and lactating mothers and provision of WASH response for flood affected populations in Lasbela, and Jhal Magsi Balochistan

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to provide Nutrition and water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) assistance to vulnerable communities affected by flooding. This UNICEF project provides fresh water to flood-affected households, prevents severe acute malnutrition among women and children, builds latrines, and provides treatment for water- and vector-borne diseases. The project provides humanitarian assistance to 62,710 people, including 25,839 women, 2,010 men, 34,861 children, and including 1,953 persons with disabilities.
